text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you! Birthday wishes from<n>you two mean
so much to me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hehe! We're not done yet! Becausewe... prepared this just for you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wait... a V cake?! Oh, that brings me<n>back! The
Victory Club staff would<n>always make them for us
on our<n>birthdays!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And of course, we also have the little<n>message
plaque too! All that's left is<n>for you to write your
goal for the year<n>on it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Write down a big dream and then<n>gobble it up,"
was it? Everyone<n>always spent ages deciding what
to<n>write.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's move to the cafeteria<n>kitchen! We
already have a chocolate<n>pen waiting!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Neither of you considered the<n>possibility
that I might not know what<n>dream to write?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Of course not! We've been cheering<n>you on as you
chase your dream for<n>years now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Write that French name nice and big!<n>Oh, and if
they're a bit tricky to spell—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Nope! I got this. ♪ Those were the<n>very first words I
learned how to<n>write.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
As above: So I'll write them nice and<n>big: "Prix de
l'Arc de Triomphe"!
